segments.ja407:1.1: Attānaṃ saṅkamaṃ katvā, yo sotthiṃ samatārayi;
segments.ja407:1.3: Kiṃ tvaṃ tesaṃ kime [kimo (sī. pī.), kiṃ me (syā.)] tuyhaṃ, honti ete [hete (syā.), so te (ka.)] mahākapi.
segments.ja407:3.1: Ullaṅghayitvā [sa laṅghayitvā (pī.), sulaṅghayitvā (ka.)] attānaṃ, vissaṭṭhadhanuno sataṃ;
segments.ja407:4.3: Sohaṃ appabhavaṃ tattha, sākhaṃ hatthehi aggahiṃ.
segments.ja407:5.1: Taṃ maṃ viyāyataṃ santaṃ, sākhāya ca latāya ca;
segments.ja407:6.1: Taṃ maṃ na tapate bandho, mato [vadho (sī. syā. pī.)] me na tapessati;
segments.ja407:7.1: Esā te upamā rāja, taṃ suṇohi arindama [atthasandassanī katā (pī.)];
segments.ja407:7.3: Raññā raṭṭhassa yoggassa, balassa nigamassa ca;
